description: Verify that the login page title 'Login' is visible when the page loads
Verify that the username input field is present and has placeholder text 'Enter username'
Verify that the password input field is present and is of type password
Verify that the login button is visible and contains the text 'Login'
Verify that entering valid credentials (username: admin, password: password123) and clicking login shows a success message
Verify that entering invalid credentials shows an error message 'Invalid username or password'
Verify that submitting the login form with empty username and password shows error 'Please fill in all fields'
Verify that entering only username without password and clicking login shows the fill-all-fields error
Verify that the success message is hidden by default and only appears after successful login
Verify that after a failed login attempt, entering correct credentials and submitting again shows success and hides the error
Verify that the error message disappears when the user tries to login again after a failed attempt
Verify that the password field masks the input characters
Verify that the navigation bar contains three links: Login, Todo, and Search
Verify that clicking the Todo navigation link shows the Todo page and hides the Login page
Verify that clicking the Search navigation link shows the Search page and hides other pages
Verify that the active navigation link has the active CSS class
Verify that navigating from Login to Todo to Search and back to Login shows the correct page each time
Verify that the Login page is shown by default when the app loads
Verify that the Todo page has a title 'Todo List'
Verify that the todo input field has placeholder text 'Add a new task...'
Verify that typing a task name and clicking Add Task adds the task to the todo list
Verify that after adding a task the input field is cleared
Verify that the task count badge updates correctly when a task is added
Verify that clicking the Delete button on a todo item removes it from the list
Verify that checking a todo checkbox applies strikethrough text decoration to the task text
Verify that adding three tasks shows count '3 tasks' then deleting one shows '2 tasks'
Verify that unchecking a previously checked todo removes the strikethrough decoration
Verify that the Add Task button is present and has text 'Add Task'
Verify that clicking Add Task with an empty input does not add any item to the list
Verify that adding multiple tasks and deleting all of them results in an empty list and 0 tasks count
Verify that each added todo item has a unique data-testid attribute
Verify that the Search page has a title 'Search'
Verify that the search input field has placeholder text 'Search...'
Verify that typing 'apple' in the search input shows 'Apple' in the search results dropdown
Verify that the search results count shows the correct number of matching results
Verify that typing 'an' shows multiple results including Banana and Mango
Verify that clicking a search result item fills the search input with the selected value
Verify that the search results dropdown disappears after selecting a result
Verify that clearing the search input hides the search results dropdown
Verify that typing a query with no matches shows no results dropdown and displays 0 results found
Verify that the search results are hidden by default when the page loads
Verify that searching for 'e' returns multiple results and the count matches the number of displayed items
Verify that navigating to Todo adding a task then navigating to Search and back to Todo still shows the added task
Verify that successful login on the Login page does not affect the Todo list when navigating to Todo
Verify that all three pages Login Todo Search have their respective titles visible when navigated to
Verify complete user flow: navigate to Todo add 2 tasks navigate to Search search for an item navigate back to Todo and verify tasks persist
Verify that the page loads within 3 seconds
Verify that the login button changes appearance on hover
Verify that the page title in the browser tab is 'Sample App'
